title: Air Quality Station Simulation via LSTM and Attention-Based Modelling
abstract: arXiv:2608.11839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Poor air quality in urban areas is driven by a complex chain of processes and presents a significant public health concern. To better understand and control the mechanisms that determine air quality, cities deploy networks of measurement stations, and launch initiatives for collecting denser data about the concentration of pollutants in the atmosphere. Extracting insights from the stations relies on their reliable and uninterrupted operation. However, hardware is susceptible to faults and black- outs that may result in data unavailability, which affects the overall quality of analyses. translated_title: 基于LSTM与注意力机制建模的空气质量站点模拟
translated_abstract: 城市地区空气质量差是由一系列复杂过程驱动的，并对公共健康构成重大威胁。为了更好地理解和控制决定空气质量的机制，城市部署了测量站点网络，并启动收集大气污染物浓度更密集数据的倡议。从站点提取洞察依赖于其可靠且不间断的运行。然而，硬件容易发生故障和断电，可能导致数据不可用，从而影响整体分析质量。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为SATADL的深度学习模型，该模型能够推断复杂关系并输出多小时后空气质量预测。该模型的目标是模拟无响应站点的测量数据，直到其运行恢复。模型的架构使其能够从不同方面提取信息。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LSTM和注意力机制的深度学习模型SATADL，用于模拟故障空气质量站点的多步预测数据，以填补数据空缺并维持分析质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SATADL, a deep learning model combining LSTM and attention mechanisms, to simulate multi-step-ahead air quality forecasts for faulty stations, ensuring data continuity and analysis quality.
